scenes.text: Right now, two golden records are flying out of our solar system with a message for aliens.
They ride on NASA's Voyager probes, launched in nineteen seventy seven.
Each one is made of gold-plated copper.
They hold greetings in fifty five languages, one hundred fifteen images, and music from around the world.
The committee that chose what went on them was chaired by astronomer Carl Sagan.
If you could add one sound to the record, what would it be?

title: We sent aliens a golden record 💿
caption: Voyager 1 and 2 each carry a gold-plated copper record with greetings in 55 languages, 115 images and music from Earth. The selection committee was chaired by Carl Sagan, born Nov 9, 1934. 🛰️
